First let us define what science is.

Science is the pursuit of understanding, knowledge and truth using rational methods - such as "the scientific method" or "positivism".

Most of the time science produces mundane results or even technological gifts. These things don't usually cause problems. However science is searching for truth and sometimes the truth is uncomfortable.

This becomes a serious problem when government is funding the science of a nation and when scientists find things that don't fit the narrative.

When science becomes politicized you can no longer trust the results either way. When science depends on grants from bureaucrats it becomes useless. At best it is reduced to producing gimmicks and cataloging things and at worst it becomes another tool of unapologetic propaganda.

The funding may - or may not as we shall see - take a hit, but ultimately free science is the only real science.

So how will we fund it? The answer is that there will be multiple sources creating a truly diverse field of researchers.

  • Charity/Crowdfunding

A lot of people donate to cancer research and with lower taxes people usually donate more to charity. This category would also include rich private persons that chose to use their funds for exploring the world or mysteries in it.

  • Corporate RND

Any company looking to create new products would have to fund labs of some kind.

  • Schools

In a free private economy people would still want to send their children to school or college. The best colleges might for example be paying their professors to teach 50% of the time and do research the other 50% of their time.

This would make sure the college could impart the latest skills and knowledge.
